description: Extract design tokens, components, layout, and motion specs from screenshots and screen-recording videos, then pair them with curated visual-theme guidance for implementation. Use this skill whenever the user wants to reverse-engineer a UI, extract a design system from screenshots or video, pull colors or typography or spacing from visuals, build a structured design spec, transform tokens to CSS or Tailwind or SwiftUI or Compose, or choose a cohesive visual theme for the resulting system. Supersedes `ui-spec-extractor` and `design-theme-library`.
